title: DFARS Version Conflict in Equitable Adjustment on Pre-2023 Contract
question: What is the correct indirect rate methodology for Sentinel's equitable adjustment proposal, and does the submitted $487,200 figure require correction?

contributor.name: Patricia Holloway
contributor.title: Contracting Officer
contributor.domain_expertise: FAR/DFARS compliance, contract modifications, T&M contract types, equitable adjustments

choices: Use actual FY24 rates for Aug-Nov 2024 and FPRA for December forward; the proposal must be self-corrected downward to approximately $461K before the ACO identifies the discrepancy
Use the FY24 actual rates for the entire period since all work occurred in FY24 and final rates are now certified; the proposal must be corrected but likely to a figure below $461K
Use the Jan 2024 DFARS revision methodology which allows FPRA rates throughout; the $487,200 is correct under current DFARS

Use FPRA rates for the entire period (Aug-Dec 2024) as submitted; the $487,200 is correct because FPRA rates are the standard for all forward-priced modifications regardless of when work was performed
